value.rationale: A sharp e^-2 rank-fraction crossover of ranked-gap/Greenwood correlations is a natural complete dependence profile of the uniform-spacing goodness-of-fit null model. It identifies which ordered gaps enhance or counteract concentration and is not determined by Greenwood or rank marginals alone. No claim of practical testing power improvement is made.
